{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# FLUX: -g 2
# The specific GPU type 'k80' is not directly translated. Flux will request 2 GPUs of any available type.
# FLUX: -n 4
# FLUX: -t 100:00:00
# FLUX: --queue=isi
# FLUX: --mail-user=xusenyin@isi.edu
# Flux does not have a direct equivalent for --mail-type=ALL. Common options are 'begin', 'end', 'abort'.

set -e -x

echo "FLUX_JOB_ID=$FLUX_JOB_ID"
echo "FLUX_JOB_NAME=$FLUX_JOB_NAME"
echo "FLUX_JOB_NODELIST=$(flux resource list)"
echo "FLUX_NNODES=$FLUX_NODE_COUNT"
# Flux does not set a SLURMTMPDIR equivalent. Using a standard temporary directory like /tmp or $TMPDIR is recommended if needed.
echo "working directory=$FLUX_SUBMIT_DIR"


if [[ $(hostname) =~ "hpc" ]]; then
    PDIR="$FLUX_SUBMIT_DIR"
    filename="$FLUX_JOB_NAME"
    extension="${filename##*.}"
    filename="${filename%.*}"
    export PYENV_ROOT="$HOME/local/lib/pyenv"
    export PATH="$PYENV_ROOT/bin:$PATH"
    if command -v pyenv 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
      eval "$(pyenv init -)"
    fi
    eval "$(pyenv virtualenv-init -)"
    pyenv activate deepdnd-drrn
else
    FWDIR="$( cd "$( dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" )" >/dev/null && pwd )"
    PDIR="$FWDIR/.."
    filename=$(basename "$0")
    extension="${filename##*.}"
    filename="${filename%.*}"
fi


if [[ -f $HOME/local/etc/init_tensorflow.sh ]]; then
    # shellcheck source=/dev/null
    source "$HOME/local/etc/init_tensorflow.sh"
fi


MODELHOME=$1
GAMEPATH=$2


pushd "$PDIR"
./sbin/run.sh python/deepword/main.py \
    --agent-clazz "CompetitionAgent" \
    --policy-to-action "LinUCB" \
    --model-dir "$MODELHOME" \
    eval-dqn \
    --game-path "$GAMEPATH" \
    --load-best
popd
"
}
